title: Why Agent Memory Needs Authority
description:
Memory is not just storage. It is a control problem about which traces are allowed to steer future action.

This cinematic brief compresses the difference between remembering more and remembering with authority, retrieval discipline, and operational trust.

It should attract viewers who have felt the pain of agent memory drift but do not yet have a clean architectural frame for it.
